phase4_correction: Phase 4 (build-time network screen) passed this repo, but the screen used targeted_api scope and missed themes/working/layouts/partials/ogimage.html, which calls resources.GetRemote at build time to download two Google Fonts and one imgur image. This is a build_time_fetch the screen should have caught.

root_cause.dead_url_status: HTTP 404 (verified 2026-09-25 via curl against github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com; the google/fonts repository no longer contains apache/robotomono - confirmed via the GitHub API directory listing, which returns "Not Found")
root_cause.mechanism: ogimage.html fetches the font with resources.GetRemote and passes it to images.Text. With the URL dead, the fetch yields no usable font and every page render fails: 0.121.2 reports "invalid text font source: string", 0.141.0 reports "invalid text font source: <nil>". Verified reproducible in fresh worktrees and in a full (non-blobless) clone.
root_cause.fixed_upstream: commit 220129d "Font URL has changed" (between selected commits 7 and 8) changed the URL to https://github.com/google/fonts/raw/main/ofl/robotomono/RobotoMono%5Bwght%5D.ttf (HTTP 200, verified) and wrapped the fetch in try; selected commit 8 (06522ce5), which contains that fix, builds successfully: 954 HTML pages in 396.677s.

phase7.reason: Phase 7 runs only when 8/8 commits build; here 7 of 8 fail, so no reproducibility rebuilds were run.

verdict_reason: 7 of 8 selected commits fail to build with their pinned Hugo versions. The failures are genuine, not environmental: the pinned Hugo extended binaries built and ran; no Go or Node toolchain is needed for the static step; the sandbox has working network. The builds fail because themes/working/layouts/partials/ogimage.html downloads a Google Font at build time from a URL that is now permanently dead (HTTP 404; the upstream google/fonts repository removed apache/robotomono). Commit 220129d fixed the URL upstream, and the one selected commit containing the fix (06522ce5) builds: 954 pages. The repo therefore does not build reproducibly across its window.
